title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment — Reflight (SAME-R)
objectives: Measure the sizes of liquid smoke particles in low gravity and relate droplet distributions to smoke generation and transport; improve measurements that were compromised in the initial SAME flight.
approach: Reuse SAME orbital hardware but change the test materials and heating/flow conditions, including use of Pyrell fire-retardant foam. Replace one diagnostics assembly with the NASA Glenn M-pass instrument. Execute 66 orbital test points and subsequent ground tests to support particle-size data analysis.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
